# deps: tools: up esbuild to v0.15.10

Pin `esbuild` at v0.15.10 in the Go toolset, following [#408](DOT-404.md) (v0.15.7; v0.15.8 and v0.15.9 came through Dependabot). `esbuild` is a JS bundler kept in the toolset; the upgrade is a change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), installed via [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go). The release notes are the [v0.15.10 tag](https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.15.10).
